name: AWS CloudTrail - Network ACL Changes

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail  (*AclEntry OR *NetworkAcl*)
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event_name 
| where event_name in ("CreateNetworkAcl","CreateNetworkAclEntry","DeleteNetworkAcl","DeleteNetworkAclEntry","ReplaceNetworkAclEntry","ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation")

description: Monitor AWS network access control list configuration changes.
